body:
HARD ARTIFACT REVIEW — REJECT the current gray-band preview as a product milestone. Retain it as a renderer, pagination, source-preservation, and provenance regression artifact.

MEASURED FROM THE ACTUAL FILES. The screenshot exposes the story text, fixture basis, a count of 18 typed rows, and dense gray strokes. preview.html contains 648 polygons and 650 SVG groups, but zero anchors, zero buttons, zero tabindex values, zero ARIA attributes, and only three document-level title elements. Every mark uses the same gray treatment. The expanded receipt tells a reader only that rows 1-18 mean hierarchy/entity/relation/context/claim lanes. It does not connect a visible stroke to a named entity, claim, context, hierarchy node, relation endpoint, or evidence record. preview.txt and codex-overview.txt prove that those useful facts exist, including exact spans and targets such as lack-arrows, speech contexts, and causal edges, but preview.html does not link or expose those twins. A sighted reader sees texture; a keyboard or screen-reader user gets story text and the receipt, not the semantics.

WHAT A READER CAN RECOVER NOW: the exact story wording; story title; researcher-reviewed fixture basis; compiler/configuration/receipt checksums; page and annotation counts; and the broad fact that five annotation families overlap the text.

WHAT REMAINS OPAQUE: which gray stroke denotes which family; entity identity and coreference; proposition predicate, roles, polarity, or modality; context kind, holder, and parent; hierarchy name and parent; temporal/causal/reference direction and endpoints; any recall unit, posterior row, external state, omission claim, or support/missing/imputed/suppressed state. The artifact is story-only despite the larger product goal. Reading receipt.json or a 1000-line twin by hand is not inspection.

DECISIONS.

1. DIRECT INPUT: ACCEPT --text, --file, and stdin now as one deterministic intake contract. Bind exact bytes, decoder, canonical text, source identity, and SurfaceAtlas. Return SemanticsUnestablished when semantic acquisition is unavailable. The source-only preview may show text, offsets, and identity; it must omit semantic bands or label them unavailable. There is no scientific harm in honest source-only intake. Blocking it merely couples deterministic custody to an interpretation the system has not earned.

2. MINIMUM REAL VERTICAL: ACCEPT the proposed two-path split, with a stronger second half.
   - arbitrary text -> source/account bundle -> source-only preview + SemanticsUnestablished;
   - admitted fixture or validated model -> semantic preview that passes the reader-recovery court below.
Do not call the first path a semantic story model, and do not call the second a recall product until it includes a real RecallGraph/HsmmResult view.

3. VISUALIZATION: REJECT the present default. The minimum useful court is not 18 lanes. It is one inspectable fact at a time, with the whole network available by focus.
   - Selecting the evidence for a sentence such as I have no arrows must reveal the exact span, typed claim, predicate, actor/object roles, polarity/modality, speech context and parent, involved entities/coreference, and containing scene/episode.
   - Selecting a causal or temporal relation must reveal its typed direction, both endpoints, and the evidence for each.
   - Selecting a recall unit, on the recall path, must reveal the full posterior row, source versus named external mass, Viterbi state as one path, support/missing/imputed/suppressed states, and the retained remainder under any display threshold.
   - Every fact needs an adjacent deterministic textual twin and non-colour labels/patterns. Every selectable item must be keyboard reachable. A clean default should show text plus a small focused neighborhood; dense all-family overlap belongs behind explicit filters.

THE COURT MUST BE ABLE TO FAIL. Use a small hand-checkable fixture truth table mapping selected span to exact visible facts. Browser/DOM assertions should select at least one claim, entity/coreference, context, hierarchy, directed relation, and recall row, then assert the exact visible text. Mutations must reverse one relation, swap one context parent or proposition role, remove one coreference mention, change one hierarchy parent, and turn one measured recall field into missing/external; each must fail the matching assertion. Capacity checks must assert nonzero focusable marks, required family coverage, a linked textual twin, and zero semantic labels when SemanticsUnestablished. Keep the existing no-script/no-network/static court and add screenshot review for density; static validity alone is not comprehension.

4. SEQUENCING: write the inspectable-visualization court and direct source-only intake now on paths disjoint from the provider repair. Once the three authority joins are repaired immutably, adopt the provider into the already typed intake. Do not call the result a product milestone until the semantic fixture passes the frozen reader court. This avoids generating more opaque artifacts before defining what a reader must recover.

YES, codex-cli-vertical-slice can help without touching provider paths. Highest value is option B: draft the fixture truth table and executable DOM/browser court, plus the source-only SemanticsUnestablished negative control. Option D is substantially answered by this review. Exact path ownership and gate still require chief assignment; do not edit provider paths.
